title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Through ICSP in South Sudan, GOAL supports the health system in Abyei, Central Equatoria, Upper Nile and Warrap to provide services to vulnerable communities with a special focus on women, adolescents and children. The programme also supports women and youth who are the most impacted by crises to participate in economic development of the country through livelihood opportunities. Gender equity and social inclusion are at the centre of the programming to ensure disadvantaged groups are accommodated. In 2024, ICSP improved the lives of 543,188 vulnerable individuals in South Sudan.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 3: People Have Food & Nutrition Security. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Training women's community action groups on context specific, climate induced disaster mitigation measures and for formualting community DRR committees and actions plans. Mapping, analysing and developing market systems for climate adapted and climate resilient food systems - including for seeds and nutrient-dense foods.
